set.pl: E. F. Branstad 120, E part of sec 1 T98N R24W (Forest Twp), about a mile east of Leland (1913 atlas)
pinev: 1913 Winnebago atlas, Forest Twp: 'E. F. Branstad 120' in the E part of sec 1, E of the Leland plat and the creek, out to the range line; matches the 1922 Register's 'about a mile east of Leland'. A separate A. E. Branstad tract in sec 4, 2.5 mi W, is other family land.
The Register original confirms 'about a mile east of Leland' and that ownership of the $1,024 was uncertain.

Sec 1 from BLM PLSS (box 43.3280-43.3423 / -93.6370 to -93.6171). A 120-acre strip on the E side of the section can run its full height, so r800 covers it; the shed site within the tract is not given.
